standard_prerequisites: Context span 2596-2610: the definitions of field trace and norm as K-trace and K-determinant of the multiplication map, with K-linearity of the trace and multiplicativity of the norm
Linear algebra: trace is additive and det multiplicative in the matrix; GL_n is generated by elementary matrices of the two displayed types
core_obligations: Trace case: both sides are additive in phi, so reduce to the matrix with a single nonzero entry a at (i, j); then both sides equal delta_ij [L : K] a (for i = j the L-trace of the scalar a is [L : K] a by the context, and the K-trace of the K-linear scalar-with-blocks map matches)

Norm case: both sides vanish when phi has a nonzero kernel, so assume phi in GL_n(L); both sides are multiplicative, and elementary-matrix reduction leaves the two types E_12(lambda) (det 1 = Norm(1)) and E_1(a) (K-determinant is the norm of a by the block decomposition), both verified by direct computation
proof_roadmap: Reduce the trace identity by additivity to single-entry matrices and compute
Reduce the norm identity by multiplicativity through GL_n to the two elementary types and compute
